submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on the token that completes a lexicalized two-part unit: the second subword of a split word (res-olutions, cons-ignment, v-ials) or the second word of a conventionalized compound, collocation, or fixed phrase (stock price, bus driver, Application form, Operating System, barbecue area, margin of, weigh-in, built into). The same word in a compositional context -- 'of' after 'thought' versus after 'margin', an adverb after 'bus'/'barbecue' versus the compound noun, or 'cons' without 'ignment' -- stays near zero.
